plainLanguage: We could not read Town of Prosper's own code pages in this research pass, so most values here are estimates that must be checked. Expect the 2021 International Residential Code with North Texas (NCTCOG) regional amendments. Nearly every new home here is in a planned development, which sets its own setbacks, masonry and garage rules, so give us your subdivision's PD number. Plan on an engineer-designed foundation because of expansive clay soils. Texas law stops the city from requiring a fixed percentage of brick or stone, but your HOA likely still will. Prosper is known for large-lot, high-standard subdivisions with significant impact fees.
